children: HUMAIN AND APPLIED INTUITION ANNOUNCE STRATEGIC COLLABORATION TO DEPLOY PHYSICAL AI ACROSS SAUDI ARABIA, STARTING WITH AUTONOMOUS TRUCKING
HUMAIN - COLLABORATION WILL BUILD LARGEST AUTONOMOUS TRUCKING NETWORK IN WORLD, ROLLING OUT THOUSANDS OF AUTONOMOUS TRUCKS ACROSS KEY SAUDI LOGISTICS CORRIDORS BY 2030
HUMAIN - COLLABORATION BRINGS TOGETHER HUMAIN’S SOVEREIGN AI INFRASTRUCTURE IN SAUDI ARABIA WITH APPLIED INTUITION’S END-TO-END PHYSICAL AI STACK FOR ALL INDUSTRIES
COMPANIES WILL FOCUS ON AUTONOMOUS TRUCKING FIRST, AND THEN EXPAND INTO LOGISTICS, ROBOTAXIS, PORTS, MINING, MANUFACTURING, AGRICULTURE, CONSTRUCTION, AND OTHER INDUSTRIES IN FUTURE
